name: Clifford.l14b_second_eq
statement:
theorem l14b_second_eq {c d z : ℂ} (hcd : c ≠ d) (hz : z ≠ 0) (h1 : dist z c = ‖c‖)
    (h2 : dist z d = ‖d‖) : z = second c d
proof:
:= by
  have k1 : (z - c) * conj (z - c) = c * conj c := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      ← Complex.dist_eq, h1]
  have k2 : (z - d) * conj (z - d) = d * conj d := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      ← Complex.dist_eq, h2]
  have hA : conj c - conj d ≠ 0 := conj_sub_ne_zero hcd
  simp only [map_sub] at k1 k2
  have key : z * (z * (conj c - conj d) - (conj c * d - c * conj d)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination (d - z) * k1 + (z - c) * k2
  have h := (mul_eq_zero.1 key).resolve_left hz
  unfold second
  rw [eq_div_iff hA]
  linear_combination h

name: Clifford.l14b_second
statement:
theorem l14b_second {M : ℂ} {s t : Sphere ℂ} (hs : M ∈ s) (ht : M ∈ t)
    (hst : s.center ≠ t.center) {P : ℂ} (h : P ∈ s ∧ P ∈ t ∧ P ≠ M) :
    P - M = second (s.center - M) (t.center - M) ∧ Transversal (s.center - M) (t.center - M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  rw [mem_sphere] at hs ht h1 h2
  have e : ∀ c : ℂ, dist (P - M) (c - M) = dist P c := fun c => by
    rw [Complex.dist_eq, Complex.dist_eq]; ring_nf
  have f : ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c - M‖ = dist M c := fun c => by rw [Complex.dist_eq, norm_sub_rev]
  have hz : P - M ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 h3
  have eq := l14b_second_eq (c := s.center - M) (d := t.center - M)
    (fun h => hst (sub_left_injective h)) hz (by rw [e, f, h1, hs]) (by rw [e, f, h2, ht])
  refine ⟨eq, fun e0 => hz ?_⟩
  rw [eq]; unfold second; rw [e0, sub_self, zero_div]

name: Clifford.l14b_genTriple
statement:
theorem l14b_genTriple {a b c : ℂ} (hab : Transversal a b) (hac : Transversal a c)
    (hbc : Transversal b c)
    (hn : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({second a b, second a c, second b c} : Set ℂ)) : GenTriple a b c
proof:
:= by
  have htri : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ) := by
    intro hcol
    have ht : triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) = 0 := by
      by_contra h; exact ((triP_ne_zero_iff a b c).1 h) hcol
    have key := cross_second hab.ne hac.ne hbc.ne
    have k2 : (conj (second a c - second a b) * (second b c - second a b) -
        (second a c - second a b) * conj (second b c - second a b)) *
        ((conj a - conj b) * (conj a - conj c) * (conj b - conj c) *
          ((a - b) * (a - c) * (b - c))) = 0 := by rw [key, ht]; ring
    have hprod : (conj a - conj b) * (conj a - conj c) * (conj b - conj c) *
        ((a - b) * (a - c) * (b - c)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (conj_sub_ne_zero hab.ne) (conj_sub_ne_zero hac.ne))
        (conj_sub_ne_zero hbc.ne)) (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.2 hab.ne)
          (sub_ne_zero.2 hac.ne)) (sub_ne_zero.2 hbc.ne))
    apply hn
    rw [collinear_iff_conj_mul]
    linear_combination (mul_eq_zero.1 k2).resolve_right hprod
  exact (genTriple_iff hab hac hbc).2 ⟨htri, hn⟩

name: Clifford.l14b_collinear_sub
statement:
theorem l14b_collinear_sub {a b c M : ℂ} (h : Collinear ℝ ({a - M, b - M, c - M} : Set ℂ)) :
    Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := a - M) (by simp)] at h
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := a) (by simp)]
  refine ⟨v, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hv (p - M) (by simp)
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    rw [vadd_eq_add, Complex.real_smul] at hr ⊢
    linear_combination hr
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hv (p - M) (by simp)
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    rw [vadd_eq_add, Complex.real_smul] at hr ⊢
    linear_combination hr

name: Clifford.l14b_cospherical_add
statement:
theorem l14b_cospherical_add {s : Set ℂ} (M : ℂ) (h : Cospherical s) :
    Cospherical ((· + M) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, r, hr⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c + M, r, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [dist_add_right]; exact hr x hx

name: Clifford.l14b_collinear_add
statement:
theorem l14b_collinear_add {s : Set ℂ} (M : ℂ) (h : Collinear ℝ s) :
    Collinear ℝ ((· + M) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, v, hv⟩ := (collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd _).1 h
  refine (collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd _).2 ⟨p + M, v, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hv x hx
  exact ⟨r, by simp only [vadd_eq_add]; ring⟩

name: Clifford.l14b_cosph_tr
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ({x, y, z, w + M} : Set ℂ) = (· + M) '' {x - M, y - M, z - M, w} := by
    simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, sub_add_cancel]
  rw [hs]; exact l14b_cospherical_add M h

name: Clifford.l14b_nc
statement:
theorem l14b_nc {a b c x y z M : ℂ} (ea : a - M = x) (eb : b - M = y) (ec : c - M = z)
    (hn : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)) : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({x, y, z} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:=
  fun h => hn (l14b_collinear_sub (by rw [ea, eb, ec]; exact h))

name: Clifford.l14b_four
statement:
theorem l14b_four {M a b c d Pab Pac Pad Pbc Pbd Pcd : ℂ} (G : GenPos4 a b c d)
    (eab : Pab - M = second a b) (eac : Pac - M = second a c) (ead : Pad - M = second a d)
    (ebc : Pbc - M = second b c) (ebd : Pbd - M = second b d) (ecd : Pcd - M = second c d) :
    Cospherical ({Pab, Pac, Pbc, miquel a b c d + M} : Set ℂ) ∧
      Cospherical ({Pab, Pad, Pbd, miquel a b c d + M} : Set ℂ) ∧
      Cospherical ({Pac, Pad, Pcd, miquel a b c d + M} : Set ℂ) ∧
      Cospherical ({Pbc, Pbd, Pcd, miquel a b c d + M} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x1, x2, x3, x4⟩ := clifford_one G
  unfold OnCircle3 at x1 x2 x3 x4
  rw [← eab, ← eac, ← ebc] at x1
  rw [← eab, ← ead, ← ebd] at x2
  rw [← eac, ← ead, ← ecd] at x3
  rw [← ebc, ← ebd, ← ecd] at x4
  exact ⟨l14b_cosph_tr x1, l14b_cosph_tr x2, l14b_cosph_tr x3, l14b_cosph_tr x4⟩

name: Clifford.l14b_img5
statement:
theorem l14b_img5 (M x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ : ℂ) :
    ({x₅ + M, x₄ + M, x₃ + M, x₂ + M, x₁ + M} : Set ℂ) = (· + M) '' {x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄, x₅}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  ext x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto

name: Clifford.l14_cliffordChain_four
statement:
theorem l14_cliffordChain_four (M : ℂ) (s₁ s₂ s₃ s₄ : Sphere ℂ)
    (hM : M ∈ s₁ ∧ M ∈ s₂ ∧ M ∈ s₃ ∧ M ∈ s₄)
    (d12 : s₁.center ≠ s₂.center) (d13 : s₁.center ≠ s₃.center) (d14 : s₁.center ≠ s₄.center)
    (d23 : s₂.center ≠ s₃.center) (d24 : s₂.center ≠ s₄.center) (d34 : s₃.center ≠ s₄.center)
    (P12 P13 P14 P23 P24 P34 : ℂ)
    (m12 : P12 ∈ s₁ ∧ P12 ∈ s₂ ∧ P12 ≠ M) (m13 : P13 ∈ s₁ ∧ P13 ∈ s₃ ∧ P13 ≠ M)
    (m14 : P14 ∈ s₁ ∧ P14 ∈ s₄ ∧ P14 ≠ M) (m23 : P23 ∈ s₂ ∧ P23 ∈ s₃ ∧ P23 ≠ M)
    (m24 : P24 ∈ s₂ ∧ P24 ∈ s₄ ∧ P24 ≠ M) (m34 : P34 ∈ s₃ ∧ P34 ∈ s₄ ∧ P34 ≠ M)
    (n123 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P12, P13, P23} : Set ℂ))
    (n124 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P12, P14, P24} : Set ℂ))
    (n134 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P13, P14, P34} : Set ℂ))
    (n234 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P23, P24, P34} : Set ℂ)) :
    ∃ P : ℂ, Cospherical ({P12, P13, P23, P} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P12, P14, P24, P} : Set ℂ) ∧
      Cospherical ({P13, P14, P34, P} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P23, P24, P34, P} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨e12, t12⟩ := l14b_second h1 h2 d12 m12
  obtain ⟨e13, t13⟩ := l14b_second h1 h3 d13 m13
  obtain ⟨e14, t14⟩ := l14b_second h1 h4 d14 m14
  obtain ⟨e23, t23⟩ := l14b_second h2 h3 d23 m23
  obtain ⟨e24, t24⟩ := l14b_second h2 h4 d24 m24
  obtain ⟨e34, t34⟩ := l14b_second h3 h4 d34 m34
  have G : GenPos4 (s₁.center - M) (s₂.center - M) (s₃.center - M) (s₄.center - M) :=
    ⟨t12, t13, t14, t23, t24, t34,
      l14b_genTriple t12 t13 t23 (l14b_nc e12 e13 e23 n123),
      l14b_genTriple t12 t14 t24 (l14b_nc e12 e14 e24 n124),
      l14b_genTriple t13 t14 t34 (l14b_nc e13 e14 e34 n134),
      l14b_genTriple t23 t24 t34 (l14b_nc e23 e24 e34 n234)⟩
  exact ⟨_, l14b_four G e12 e13 e14 e23 e24 e34⟩

name: Clifford.l14_cliffordChain_five
statement:
theorem l14_cliffordChain_five (M : ℂ) (s₁ s₂ s₃ s₄ s₅ : Sphere ℂ)
    (hM : M ∈ s₁ ∧ M ∈ s₂ ∧ M ∈ s₃ ∧ M ∈ s₄ ∧ M ∈ s₅)
    (d12 : s₁.center ≠ s₂.center) (d13 : s₁.center ≠ s₃.center) (d14 : s₁.center ≠ s₄.center)
    (d15 : s₁.center ≠ s₅.center) (d23 : s₂.center ≠ s₃.center) (d24 : s₂.center ≠ s₄.center)
    (d25 : s₂.center ≠ s₅.center) (d34 : s₃.center ≠ s₄.center) (d35 : s₃.center ≠ s₅.center)
    (d45 : s₄.center ≠ s₅.center)
    (P12 P13 P14 P15 P23 P24 P25 P34 P35 P45 : ℂ)
    (m12 : P12 ∈ s₁ ∧ P12 ∈ s₂ ∧ P12 ≠ M) (m13 : P13 ∈ s₁ ∧ P13 ∈ s₃ ∧ P13 ≠ M)
    (m14 : P14 ∈ s₁ ∧ P14 ∈ s₄ ∧ P14 ≠ M) (m15 : P15 ∈ s₁ ∧ P15 ∈ s₅ ∧ P15 ≠ M)
    (m23 : P23 ∈ s₂ ∧ P23 ∈ s₃ ∧ P23 ≠ M) (m24 : P24 ∈ s₂ ∧ P24 ∈ s₄ ∧ P24 ≠ M)
    (m25 : P25 ∈ s₂ ∧ P25 ∈ s₅ ∧ P25 ≠ M) (m34 : P34 ∈ s₃ ∧ P34 ∈ s₄ ∧ P34 ≠ M)
    (m35 : P35 ∈ s₃ ∧ P35 ∈ s₅ ∧ P35 ≠ M) (m45 : P45 ∈ s₄ ∧ P45 ∈ s₅ ∧ P45 ≠ M)
    (n123 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P12, P13, P23} : Set ℂ)) (n124 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P12, P14, P24} : Set ℂ))
    (n125 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P12, P15, P25} : Set ℂ)) (n134 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P13, P14, P34} : Set ℂ))
    (n135 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P13, P15, P35} : Set ℂ)) (n145 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P14, P15, P45} : Set ℂ))
    (n234 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P23, P24, P34} : Set ℂ)) (n235 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P23, P25, P35} : Set ℂ))
    (n245 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P24, P25, P45} : Set ℂ)) (n345 : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P34, P35, P45} : Set ℂ)) :
    ∃ Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ Q₄ Q₅ : ℂ,
      (Cospherical ({P23, P24, P34, Q₁} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P23, P25, P35, Q₁} : Set ℂ) ∧
        Cospherical ({P24, P25, P45, Q₁} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P34, P35, P45, Q₁} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (Cospherical ({P13, P14, P34, Q₂} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P13, P15, P35, Q₂} : Set ℂ) ∧
        Cospherical ({P14, P15, P45, Q₂} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P34, P35, P45, Q₂} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (Cospherical ({P12, P14, P24, Q₃} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P12, P15, P25, Q₃} : Set ℂ) ∧
        Cospherical ({P14, P15, P45, Q₃} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P24, P25, P45, Q₃} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (Cospherical ({P12, P13, P23, Q₄} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P12, P15, P25, Q₄} : Set ℂ) ∧
        Cospherical ({P13, P15, P35, Q₄} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P23, P25, P35, Q₄} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (Cospherical ({P12, P13, P23, Q₅} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P12, P14, P24, Q₅} : Set ℂ) ∧
        Cospherical ({P13, P14, P34, Q₅} : Set ℂ) ∧ Cospherical ({P23, P24, P34, Q₅} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (Cospherical ({Q₁, Q₂, Q₃, Q₄, Q₅} : Set ℂ) ∨ Collinear ℝ ({Q₁, Q₂, Q₃, Q₄, Q₅} : Set ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨e12, t12⟩ := l14b_second h1 h2 d12 m12
  obtain ⟨e13, t13⟩ := l14b_second h1 h3 d13 m13
  obtain ⟨e14, t14⟩ := l14b_second h1 h4 d14 m14
  obtain ⟨e15, t15⟩ := l14b_second h1 h5 d15 m15
  obtain ⟨e23, t23⟩ := l14b_second h2 h3 d23 m23
  obtain ⟨e24, t24⟩ := l14b_second h2 h4 d24 m24
  obtain ⟨e25, t25⟩ := l14b_second h2 h5 d25 m25
  obtain ⟨e34, t34⟩ := l14b_second h3 h4 d34 m34
  obtain ⟨e35, t35⟩ := l14b_second h3 h5 d35 m35
  obtain ⟨e45, t45⟩ := l14b_second h4 h5 d45 m45
  have G : GenPos5 (s₁.center - M) (s₂.center - M) (s₃.center - M) (s₄.center - M)
      (s₅.center - M) :=
    ⟨t12, t13, t14, t15, t23, t24, t25, t34, t35, t45,
      l14b_genTriple t12 t13 t23 (l14b_nc e12 e13 e23 n123),
      l14b_genTriple t12 t14 t24 (l14b_nc e12 e14 e24 n124),
      l14b_genTriple t12 t15 t25 (l14b_nc e12 e15 e25 n125),
      l14b_genTriple t13 t14 t34 (l14b_nc e13 e14 e34 n134),
      l14b_genTriple t13 t15 t35 (l14b_nc e13 e15 e35 n135),
      l14b_genTriple t14 t15 t45 (l14b_nc e14 e15 e45 n145),
      l14b_genTriple t23 t24 t34 (l14b_nc e23 e24 e34 n234),
      l14b_genTriple t23 t25 t35 (l14b_nc e23 e25 e35 n235),
      l14b_genTriple t24 t25 t45 (l14b_nc e24 e25 e45 n245),
      l14b_genTriple t34 t35 t45 (l14b_nc e34 e35 e45 n345)⟩
  have A := l14b_four G.pos4_bcde e23 e24 e25 e34 e35 e45
  have B := l14b_four G.pos4_acde e13 e14 e15 e34 e35 e45
  have C := l14b_four G.pos4_abde e12 e14 e15 e24 e25 e45
  have D := l14b_four G.pos4_abce e12 e13 e15 e23 e25 e35
  have E := l14b_four G.pos4_abcd e12 e13 e14 e23 e24 e34
  refine ⟨_, _, _, _, _, A, B, C, D, E, ?_⟩
  rw [l14b_img5]
  rcases clifford_two_clean G with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (l14b_cospherical_add M h)
  · exact Or.inr (l14b_collinear_add M h)

name: Clifford.l14b_mem
statement:
theorem l14b_mem {z c : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (h : (z.re - c.re) ^ 2 + (z.im - c.im) ^ 2 = r) :
    z ∈ (⟨c, Real.sqrt r⟩ : Sphere ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sphere, Complex.dist_eq, Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
  congr 1
  simp only [sub_re, sub_im]
  linear_combination h

name: Clifford.l14b_cosph
statement:
theorem l14b_cosph {s : Set ℂ} (o : ℂ) (r : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, (x.re - o.re) ^ 2 + (x.im - o.im) ^ 2 = r) : Cospherical s
proof:
:=
  ⟨o, Real.sqrt r, fun x hx => l14b_mem (h x hx)⟩

name: Clifford.l14b_not_collinear
proof:

name: Clifford.l14_not_cliffordChain_six
statement:
theorem l14_not_cliffordChain_six :
    ∃ c : Fin 6 → ℂ,
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ Collinear ℝ ({0, c i, c j} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ i j k, i < j → j < k → ¬ Collinear ℝ ({c i, c j, c k} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ S : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ,
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → S (c i) (c j) ∈ Metric.sphere (c i) ‖c i‖ ∧
          S (c i) (c j) ∈ Metric.sphere (c j) ‖c j‖ ∧ S (c i) (c j) ≠ 0) →
        (∀ i j k, i < j → j < k →
          ¬ Collinear ℝ ({S (c i) (c j), S (c i) (c k), S (c j) (c k)} : Set ℂ)) ∧
        ¬ ∃ p : ℂ, ∀ i : Fin 6, ∃ Y : Set ℂ,
          ((∃ o : ℂ, ∃ r : ℝ, Y = Metric.sphere o r) ∨ ∃ a b : ℂ, a ≠ b ∧ Y = line[ℝ, a, b]) ∧
          p ∈ Y ∧ ∀ j : Fin 5, ∃ q ∈ Y, ∀ k : Fin 4,
            Cospherical ({S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 0))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 1)))),
              S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 0))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 2)))),
              S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 1))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 2)))), q} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have G := Counter6.cx_genPosN
  refine ⟨Counter6.cx, fun i j h => (transversal_iff _ _).1 (G.1 i j h),
    fun i j k h1 h2 => ((genTriple_iff (G.1 i j (ne_of_lt h1)) (G.1 i k (ne_of_lt (h1.trans h2)))
      (G.1 j k (ne_of_lt h2))).1 (G.2 i j k h1 h2)).1, fun S hS => ?_⟩
  have hS' : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → S (Counter6.cx a) (Counter6.cx b) =
      second (Counter6.cx a) (Counter6.cx b) := fun a b hab => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hS a b hab
    exact l14b_second_eq (G.1 a b hab).ne h3 (Metric.mem_sphere.1 h1) (Metric.mem_sphere.1 h2)
  refine ⟨fun i j k h1 h2 => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hS' _ _ (ne_of_lt h1), hS' _ _ (ne_of_lt (h1.trans h2)), hS' _ _ (ne_of_lt h2)]
    exact ((genTriple_iff (G.1 i j (ne_of_lt h1)) (G.1 i k (ne_of_lt (h1.trans h2)))
      (G.1 j k (ne_of_lt h2))).1 (G.2 i j k h1 h2)).2
  rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
  have key : ∀ σ : Fin 3 → Fin 6, Function.Injective σ → ∀ q : ℂ,
      Cospherical ({S (Counter6.cx (σ 0)) (Counter6.cx (σ 1)),
        S (Counter6.cx (σ 0)) (Counter6.cx (σ 2)), S (Counter6.cx (σ 1)) (Counter6.cx (σ 2)), q} :
          Set ℂ) →
      OnCircle3 (second (Counter6.cx (σ 0)) (Counter6.cx (σ 1)))
        (second (Counter6.cx (σ 0)) (Counter6.cx (σ 2)))
        (second (Counter6.cx (σ 1)) (Counter6.cx (σ 2))) q := by
    intro σ hσ q h
    rw [hS' _ _ (hσ.ne (by decide)), hS' _ _ (hσ.ne (by decide)),
      hS' _ _ (hσ.ne (by decide))] at h
    exact h
  apply Counter6.not_chain6 (X := {p})
  show ∃ p', ({p} : Set ℂ) = {p'} ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 6, ∃ Y, Chain 5 (Counter6.cx ∘ i.succAbove) Y ∧ p' ∈ Y
  refine ⟨p, rfl, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hpY, hq⟩ := hp i
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, hpY⟩
  show IsGCircle Y ∧ ∀ j : Fin 5, ∃ q, Chain 4 ((Counter6.cx ∘ i.succAbove) ∘ j.succAbove) {q} ∧
    q ∈ Y
  refine ⟨l14b_isGCircle hY, fun j => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hqY, hk⟩ := hq j
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hqY⟩
  show ∃ p', ({q} : Set ℂ) = {p'} ∧ ∀ k : Fin 4,
    ∃ Y', Chain 3 (((Counter6.cx ∘ i.succAbove) ∘ j.succAbove) ∘ k.succAbove) Y' ∧ p' ∈ Y'
  refine ⟨q, rfl, fun k => chain3_of _ q ?_⟩
  exact key (i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove ∘ k.succAbove)
    (Fin.succAbove_right_injective.comp (Fin.succAbove_right_injective.comp
      Fin.succAbove_right_injective)) q (hk k)

statement:
theorem cov_D1_d_odd_three_part (c : Fin 3 → Sphere Pt) (M : Pt)
    (pt : Finset (Fin 3) → Pt) (circ : Finset (Fin 3) → Sphere Pt)
    (h : CliffordChain 3 c M pt circ)
    (hnc : ¬ Collinear ℝ (Set.range fun i => pt (Finset.univ.erase i))) :
    Cospherical (Set.range fun i => pt (Finset.univ.erase i))
proof:
:= by
  let a := pt (Finset.univ.erase 0)
  let b := pt (Finset.univ.erase 1)
  let c' := pt (Finset.univ.erase 2)
  have heq : (Set.range fun i => pt (Finset.univ.erase i)) = {a,b,c'} := by
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp [a,b,c']
    · rintro (rfl|rfl|rfl)
      · exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2,rfl⟩
  rw [heq] at hnc ⊢
  let t : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt := ⟨![a,b,c'], affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.2 hnc⟩
  refine ⟨t.circumcenter,t.circumradius,?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl|rfl|rfl
  · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 0
  · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 1
  · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 2

name: Clifford.resD_id
statement:
theorem resD_id (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ : R) :
    let a := det4 y₁ (y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ * x₁) x₁ y₂ (y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ * x₂) x₂ y₃ (y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ * x₃) x₃ 0 0 y₄ 1
    let b := det4 y₁ (y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ * x₁) x₁ y₂ (y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ * x₂) x₂ y₃ (y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ * x₃) x₃ y₄ (y₄ ^ 2) 0 0
    let e₂ := det4 x₁ (x₁ ^ 2) (x₁ * y₁) y₁ x₂ (x₂ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) y₂ x₃ (x₃ ^ 2) (x₃ * y₃) y₃ 0 1 0 0
    let e₁ := det4 x₁ (x₁ ^ 2) (x₁ * y₁) y₁ x₂ (x₂ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) y₂ x₃ (x₃ ^ 2) (x₃ * y₃) y₃ 1 0 y₄ 0
    a ^ 2 * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ - mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ * (e₂ * (a * x₄ - b) + e₁ * a) =
      y₄ * (y₁ - y₄) * (y₂ - y₄) * (y₃ - y₄) * crs x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ * crs x₁ x₃ y₁ y₃ *
        crs x₂ x₃ y₂ y₃ * triP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ * cycP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃
proof:
:= by
  intro a b e₂ e₁
  simp only [a, b, e₂, e₁, mD, crs, triP, cycP, det4, det3]
  ring

name: Clifford.detU
statement:
theorem detU (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ z : R) :
    det4 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (x₁ ^ 2 * (x₁ - z)) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂)
      (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2) (x₂ ^ 2 * (x₂ - z)) (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) (x₃ ^ 2 * (x₃ - z))
      (x₄ * y₄) (x₄ ^ 2 * y₄) (x₄ * y₄ ^ 2) (x₄ ^ 2 * (x₄ - z)) =
      -(x₁ * x₂ * x₃ * x₄) * (mN x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ - z * mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mN mD det4 det3; ring

name: Clifford.detV
statement:
theorem detV (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ Z : R) :
    det4 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ ^ 2 * (y₁ - Z)) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂)
      (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ ^ 2 * (y₂ - Z)) (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ ^ 2 * (y₃ - Z))
      (x₄ * y₄) (x₄ ^ 2 * y₄) (x₄ * y₄ ^ 2) (y₄ ^ 2 * (y₄ - Z)) =
      y₁ * y₂ * y₃ * y₄ * (mN y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ - Z * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mN mD det4 det3; ring

name: Clifford.detT
statement:
theorem detT (x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : R) :
    det3 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂) (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2)
      (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) =
      x₁ * y₁ * x₂ * y₂ * x₃ * y₃ * triP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃
proof:
:= by
  unfold triP det3; ring

name: Clifford.kK_dj
statement:
theorem kK_dj (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ y₅ z Z : R) :
    kK x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ y₅ z Z * (x₁ * y₁ * x₂ * y₂ * x₃ * y₃ * triP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃) =
      (-(x₁ * x₂ * x₃ * x₄) * (mN x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ - z * mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄)) *
        (y₁ * y₂ * y₃ * y₅ * (mN y₁ y₂ y₃ y₅ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₅ - Z * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₅ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₅)) -
      (y₁ * y₂ * y₃ * y₄ * (mN y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ - Z * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄)) *
        (-(x₁ * x₂ * x₃ * x₅) * (mN x₁ x₂ x₃ x₅ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₅ - z * mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₅ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₅))
proof:
:= by
  have h := det5_mul_det3 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (x₁ ^ 2 * (x₁ - z)) (y₁ ^ 2 * (y₁ - Z)) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂) (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2) (x₂ ^ 2 * (x₂ - z)) (y₂ ^ 2 * (y₂ - Z)) (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) (x₃ ^ 2 * (x₃ - z)) (y₃ ^ 2 * (y₃ - Z)) (x₄ * y₄) (x₄ ^ 2 * y₄) (x₄ * y₄ ^ 2) (x₄ ^ 2 * (x₄ - z)) (y₄ ^ 2 * (y₄ - Z)) (x₅ * y₅) (x₅ ^ 2 * y₅) (x₅ * y₅ ^ 2) (x₅ ^ 2 * (x₅ - z)) (y₅ ^ 2 * (y₅ - Z))
  rw [detU, detU, detV, detV, detT] at h
  exact h

  rw [OnCircleM, Complex.ext_iff]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.add_re,
    Complex.add_im]
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨by linear_combination h, by ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, -⟩; linear_combination h

name: Clifford.conj_sub_ne_zero
statement: theorem conj_sub_ne_zero {c d : ℂ} (h : c ≠ d) : conj c - conj d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_sub]; exact (map_ne_zero _).2 (sub_ne_zero.2 h)

name: Clifford.second_eq_coords
statement:
theorem second_eq_coords {c d : ℂ} (h : c ≠ d) :
    second c d =
      ⟨2 * (c.im * (c.re - d.re) - c.re * (c.im - d.im)) / ((c.re - d.re) ^ 2 + (c.im - d.im) ^ 2) *
          -(c.im - d.im),
        2 * (c.im * (c.re - d.re) - c.re * (c.im - d.im)) / ((c.re - d.re) ^ 2 + (c.im - d.im) ^ 2) *
          (c.re - d.re)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (c.re - d.re) ^ 2 + (c.im - d.im) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 : c.re - d.re = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c.re - d.re), sq_nonneg (c.im - d.im)]
    have h2 : c.im - d.im = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c.re - d.re), sq_nonneg (c.im - d.im)]
    exact h (Complex.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h1) (sub_eq_zero.1 h2))
  have hd := conj_sub_ne_zero h
  rw [second, div_eq_iff hd]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.conj_re,
      Complex.conj_im] <;>
    field_simp <;> ring

name: Clifford.conj_second
statement: theorem conj_second (c d : ℂ) : conj (second c d) = (c * conj d - conj c * d) / (c - d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold second; rw [map_div₀]; simp only [map_sub, map_mul, starRingEnd_self_apply]

name: Clifford.second_onCircleM_left
statement: theorem second_onCircleM_left {c d : ℂ} (h : c ≠ d) : OnCircleM c (second c d)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := conj_sub_ne_zero h; have he := sub_ne_zero.2 h
  rw [onCircleM_iff, conj_second, second]; field_simp; ring

name: Clifford.second_onCircleM_right
statement: theorem second_onCircleM_right {c d : ℂ} (h : c ≠ d) : OnCircleM d (second c d)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := conj_sub_ne_zero h; have he := sub_ne_zero.2 h
  rw [onCircleM_iff, conj_second, second]; field_simp; ring

name: Clifford.second_ne_zero
statement: theorem second_ne_zero {c d : ℂ} (h : Transversal c d) : second c d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold second
  exact div_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.2 h) (conj_sub_ne_zero h.ne)

name: Clifford.circ_of_eq
statement:
theorem circ_of_eq {g₀ g₁ g₂ cy z Z : ℂ} (hcy : cy ≠ 0) (h : g₀ - z * g₁ - Z * g₂ + z * Z * cy = 0) :
    (z - g₂ / cy) * (Z - g₁ / cy) = (g₁ * g₂ - g₀ * cy) / cy ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have e : (z - g₂ / cy) * (Z - g₁ / cy) - (g₁ * g₂ - g₀ * cy) / cy ^ 2 =
      (g₀ - z * g₁ - Z * g₂ + z * Z * cy) / cy := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [h, zero_div, sub_eq_zero] at e; exact e

name: Clifford.cospherical_of_eq
statement:
theorem cospherical_of_eq {s : Set ℂ} {g₀ g₁ g₂ cy : ℂ} (hcy : cy ≠ 0)
    (ho : conj (g₂ / cy) = g₁ / cy)
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ s, g₀ - z * g₁ - conj z * g₂ + z * conj z * cy = 0) : Cospherical s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨g₂ / cy, √(((g₁ * g₂ - g₀ * cy) / cy ^ 2).re), fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have h1 := circ_of_eq hcy (hs z hz)
  rw [← ho, ← map_sub, Complex.mul_conj] at h1
  rw [Complex.dist_eq, Complex.norm_def, ← h1, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: Clifford.second_on
statement:
theorem second_on {g₀ g₁ g₂ cy c d : ℂ} (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (h : g₀ * ((conj c - conj d) * (c - d)) - g₁ * ((conj c * d - c * conj d) * (c - d)) -
      g₂ * ((c * conj d - conj c * d) * (conj c - conj d)) +
      cy * ((conj c * d - c * conj d) * (c * conj d - conj c * d)) = 0) :
    g₀ - second c d * g₁ - conj (second c d) * g₂ + second c d * conj (second c d) * cy = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := conj_sub_ne_zero hcd; have he := sub_ne_zero.2 hcd
  have key : g₀ - second c d * g₁ - conj (second c d) * g₂ + second c d * conj (second c d) * cy =
      (g₀ * ((conj c - conj d) * (c - d)) - g₁ * ((conj c * d - c * conj d) * (c - d)) -
      g₂ * ((c * conj d - conj c * d) * (conj c - conj d)) +
      cy * ((conj c * d - c * conj d) * (c * conj d - conj c * d))) /
        ((conj c - conj d) * (c - d)) := by
    rw [conj_second, second]; field_simp
  rw [key, h, zero_div]

name: Clifford.ratio_on
statement:
theorem ratio_on {g₀ g₁ g₂ cy N D Nb Db q : ℂ} (hD : D ≠ 0) (hDb : Db ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : D * g₀ - N * g₁ = Nb * q) (h₂ : D * g₂ - N * cy = Db * q) :
    g₀ - N / D * g₁ - Nb / Db * g₂ + N / D * (Nb / Db) * cy = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : g₀ - N / D * g₁ - Nb / Db * g₂ + N / D * (Nb / Db) * cy =
      (Db * (D * g₀ - N * g₁) - Nb * (D * g₂ - N * cy)) / (D * Db) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [e, h₁, h₂]; ring

name: Clifford.conj_mN
statement:
theorem conj_mN (a b c d : ℂ) :
    conj (mN a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d)) =
      mN (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mN]; simp only [starRingEnd_self_apply]

name: Clifford.conj_mD
statement:
theorem conj_mD (a b c d : ℂ) :
    conj (mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d)) =
      mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d
proof:
:= by

name: Clifford.conj_miquel
statement:
theorem conj_miquel (a b c d : ℂ) :
    conj (miquel a b c d) =
      mN (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d / mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [miquel, map_div₀, conj_mN, conj_mD]

name: Clifford.mD_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mD_ne_zero {a b c d : ℂ} (hab : Transversal a b) (hac : Transversal a c)
    (hbc : Transversal b c) (had : Transversal a d) (hbd : Transversal b d) (hcd : Transversal c d)
    (ht : GenTriple a b c) : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d = 0 := by rw [← conj_mD, h, map_zero]
  have := resD h h'
  have hd : conj d ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).2 hcd.right_ne_zero
  refine absurd this ?_
  refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero hd (conj_sub_ne_zero had.ne)) (conj_sub_ne_zero hbd.ne)) (conj_sub_ne_zero hcd.ne))
    ?_) ?_) ?_) ht.1) ht.2
  · exact sub_ne_zero.2 hab
  · exact sub_ne_zero.2 hac
  · exact sub_ne_zero.2 hbc

name: Clifford.miquel_mul
statement:
theorem miquel_mul (a b c d : ℂ) (hD : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0) :
    mN a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) -
      miquel a b c d * mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [miquel, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hD, sub_self]

name: Clifford.conj_miquel_mul
statement:
theorem conj_miquel_mul (a b c d : ℂ) (hD : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0) :
    mN (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d -
      conj (miquel a b c d) * mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hDb : mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← conj_mD]; exact (map_ne_zero _).2 hD
  rw [conj_miquel, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hDb, sub_self]

name: Clifford.gamma_cospherical
statement:
theorem gamma_cospherical {a b c d : ℂ} (hab : Transversal a b) (hac : Transversal a c)
    (hbc : Transversal b c) (ht : GenTriple a b c)
    (hD : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0) :
    Cospherical ({second a b, second a c, second b c, miquel a b c d} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hDb : mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← conj_mD]; exact (map_ne_zero _).2 hD
  refine cospherical_of_eq (g₀ := gq0 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c))
    (g₁ := gq1 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c)) (g₂ := gq2 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c))
    ht.2 ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_div₀, map_gq2, map_cycP]
    simp only [starRingEnd_self_apply]
    rw [gq2_swap, cycP_swap, neg_div_neg_eq]
  · intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact second_on hab.ne (gq_P12 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c))
    · exact second_on hac.ne (gq_P13 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c))
    · exact second_on hbc.ne (gq_P23 a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c))
    · rw [conj_miquel]
      exact ratio_on hD hDb (certA₁ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) (certA₂ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)

name: Clifford.clifford_one
statement:
theorem clifford_one {a b c d : ℂ} (h : GenPos4 a b c d) :
    OnCircle3 (second a b) (second a c) (second b c) (miquel a b c d) ∧
    OnCircle3 (second a b) (second a d) (second b d) (miquel a b c d) ∧
    OnCircle3 (second a c) (second a d) (second c d) (miquel a b c d) ∧
    OnCircle3 (second b c) (second b d) (second c d) (miquel a b c d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact gamma_cospherical h.ab h.ac h.bc h.abc
      (mD_ne_zero h.ab h.ac h.bc h.ad h.bd h.cd h.abc)
  · rw [← miquel_p1243]
    exact gamma_cospherical h.ab h.ad h.bd h.abd
      (mD_ne_zero h.ab h.ad h.bd h.ac h.bc (cd_symm h.cd) h.abd)
  · rw [← miquel_p1342]
    exact gamma_cospherical h.ac h.ad h.cd h.acd
      (mD_ne_zero h.ac h.ad h.cd h.ab (cd_symm h.bc) (cd_symm h.bd) h.acd)
  · rw [← miquel_p2341]
    exact gamma_cospherical h.bc h.bd h.cd h.bcd
      (mD_ne_zero h.bc h.bd h.cd (cd_symm h.ab) (cd_symm h.ac) (cd_symm h.ad) h.bcd)

name: Clifford.cliffordEq_miquel
statement:
theorem cliffordEq_miquel {a b c d e : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (ht : triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) ≠ 0)
    (hD : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0) :
    cliffordEq a b c d e (miquel a b c d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := kK_dj a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e)
    (miquel a b c d) (conj (miquel a b c d))
  rw [miquel_mul a b c d hD, conj_miquel_mul a b c d hD] at h
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h
  have hne : a * conj a * b * conj b * c * conj c * triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha
      (conj_ne_zero' ha)) hb) (conj_ne_zero' hb)) hc) (conj_ne_zero' hc)) ht
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right hne

name: Clifford.clifford_two
statement:
theorem clifford_two {a b c d e : ℂ} (h : GenPos5 a b c d e) (hk : CliffordNondeg a b c d e) :
    Cospherical ({miquel a b c d, miquel a b c e, miquel a b d e, miquel a c d e, miquel b c d e} :
      Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine cospherical_of_eq (g₀ := k0 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e))
    (g₁ := k1 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e))
    (g₂ := k2 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e)) hk ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_div₀, map_k2, map_k3]
    simp only [starRingEnd_self_apply]
    rw [k2_swap, k3_swap]
  · have key : ∀ z, cliffordEq a b c d e z = 0 →
        k0 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) -
          z * k1 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) -
          conj z * k2 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) +
          z * conj z * k3 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) = 0 := by
      intro z hz; rw [cliffordEq, kK_expand] at hz; exact hz
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    apply key
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h.pos4_abcd.cliffordEq_miquel e
    · have h1 := h.pos4_abce.cliffordEq_miquel d
      rw [cliffordEq, kK_p12354, neg_eq_zero] at h1; exact h1
    · have h1 := h.pos4_abde.cliffordEq_miquel c
      rw [cliffordEq, kK_p12453] at h1; exact h1
    · have h1 := h.pos4_acde.cliffordEq_miquel b
      rw [cliffordEq, kK_p13452, neg_eq_zero] at h1; exact h1
    · have h1 := h.pos4_bcde.cliffordEq_miquel a
      rw [cliffordEq, kK_p23451] at h1; exact h1

name: Clifford.cospherical_or_collinear
statement:
theorem cospherical_or_collinear (a b c : ℂ) :
    Cospherical ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ) ∨ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)
  · exact Or.inr h
  · left
    have hi : AffineIndependent ℝ ![a, b, c] := by
      rw [affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set]; exact h
    let t : Affine.Triangle ℝ ℂ := ⟨![a, b, c], hi⟩
    refine ⟨t.circumcenter, t.circumradius, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 0
    · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 1
    · rw [dist_comm]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius' 2

name: Clifford.cliffordChain_three
statement: theorem cliffordChain_three : CliffordChain 3
proof:
:= by
  intro c _
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hs⟩ := exists_gcircle
    (cospherical_or_collinear (second (c 1) (c 2)) (second (c 0) (c 2)) (second (c 0) (c 1)))
  refine ⟨X, hX, fun i => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨second (c 1) (c 2), rfl, hs (Set.mem_insert _ _)⟩
  · exact ⟨second (c 0) (c 2), rfl, hs (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))⟩
  · exact ⟨second (c 0) (c 1), rfl,
      hs (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))⟩

name: Clifford.not_chain_of_extends
statement:
theorem not_chain_of_extends : ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 6) → ℂ),
    (∀ k : Fin 6, c (Fin.castLE (by omega) k) = Counter6.cx k) → ∀ X, ¬ Chain (m + 6) c X
proof:
| 0, c, hc, X => by
    have : c = Counter6.cx := funext fun k => hc k
    subst this; exact Counter6.not_chain6
  | m + 1, c, hc, X => by
    intro h
    have hc' : ∀ k : Fin 6, (c ∘ (Fin.last (m + 6)).succAbove) (Fin.castLE (by omega) k) =
        Counter6.cx k := fun k => by
      rw [Fin.succAbove_last, Function.comp_apply, ← hc k]; rfl
    have h' : Chain (m + 4 + 3) c X := h
    rw [Chain] at h'
    split_ifs at h'
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, -⟩ := h'.2 (Fin.last _)
      exact not_chain_of_extends m _ hc' _ hp
    · obtain ⟨p, -, h'⟩ := h'
      obtain ⟨Y, hY, -⟩ := h' (Fin.last _)
      exact not_chain_of_extends m _ hc' _ hY

name: Clifford.conj_par
statement: theorem conj_par (t : ℝ) : conj (par t) = t - I * (t : ℂ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [par, map_add, map_mul, conj_ofReal, conj_I]; ring

name: Clifford.eval_pZ
statement: theorem eval_pZ (t : ℝ) : (pZ.eval (t : ℂ)) = par t
proof: := by simp [pZ, par]

name: Clifford.eval_pZb
statement: theorem eval_pZb (t : ℝ) : (pZb.eval (t : ℂ)) = conj (par t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_par]; simp [pZb]

name: Clifford.finite_roots
statement: theorem finite_roots {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : {t : ℝ | p.eval (t : ℂ) = 0}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp).preimage (Complex.ofReal_injective.injOn)

name: Clifford.eval_pA
statement: theorem eval_pA (a : ℂ) (t : ℝ) : (pA a).eval (t : ℂ) = conj a * par t - a * conj (par t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pA, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pZ, eval_pZb]

name: Clifford.pA_ne_zero
statement: theorem pA_ne_zero {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) : pA a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := eval_pA a 1; have h2 := eval_pA a (-1)
  rw [h, eval_zero] at h1 h2
  apply ha
  have e1 := congrArg Complex.re h1; have e2 := congrArg Complex.im h1
  have e3 := congrArg Complex.re h2; have e4 := congrArg Complex.im h2
  simp [par] at e1 e2 e3 e4
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp <;> nlinarith

name: Clifford.eval_pT
statement:
theorem eval_pT (a b : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    (pT a b).eval (t : ℂ) = triP a b (par t) (conj a) (conj b) (conj (par t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_par]; simp [pT, pZ, pZb, par, triP, det3]

name: Clifford.pT_ne_zero
statement: theorem pT_ne_zero {a b : ℂ} (h : Transversal a b) : pT a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 := eval_pT a b 0
  rw [h0, eval_zero] at h1
  apply h
  simp [par, triP, det3] at h1
  linear_combination h1

name: Clifford.eval_pC
statement:
theorem eval_pC (a b : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    (pC a b).eval (t : ℂ) = cycP a b (par t) (conj a) (conj b) (conj (par t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_par]; simp [pC, pZ, pZb, par, cycP, det3]

name: Clifford.pC_ne_zero
statement: theorem pC_ne_zero {a b : ℂ} (h : Transversal a b) : pC a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have e : ∀ t : ℝ, cycP a b (t + I * (t : ℂ) ^ 2) (conj a) (conj b) (t - I * (t : ℂ) ^ 2) = 0 :=
    fun t => by rw [← conj_par]; exact (eval_pC a b t).symm.trans (by rw [h0, eval_zero])
  have e0 := e 0; have e1 := e 1; have e2 := e (-1); have e3 := e 2; have e4 := e (-2)
  simp only [cycP, det3] at e0 e1 e2 e3 e4
  push_cast at e0 e1 e2 e3 e4
  apply h
  linear_combination (-1 / 4 : ℂ) * e1 + (-1 / 12 : ℂ) * e2 + (1 / 12 : ℂ) * e3 +
    (conj a * b - a * conj b) * I_sq

name: Clifford.finite_bad
statement:
theorem finite_bad {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Transversal (c i) (c j)) :
    {t : ℝ | (∃ i, ¬ Transversal (c i) (par t)) ∨
      ∃ i j, i < j ∧ ¬ GenTriple (c i) (c j) (par t)}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ∀ i, {t : ℝ | ¬ Transversal (c i) (par t)}.Finite := fun i => by
    refine (finite_roots (pA_ne_zero (hc i))).subset fun t ht => ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Transversal, not_not] at ht ⊢
    rw [eval_pA, ht, sub_self]
  have hT : ∀ i j, i < j → {t : ℝ | ¬ GenTriple (c i) (c j) (par t)}.Finite := fun i j hij => by
    refine ((finite_roots (pT_ne_zero (h i j hij.ne))).union
      (finite_roots (pC_ne_zero (h i j hij.ne)))).subset fun t ht => ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, GenTriple, not_and_or, not_not] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · left; simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; rw [eval_pT]; exact ht
    · right; simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; rw [eval_pC]; exact ht
  have e : {t : ℝ | (∃ i, ¬ Transversal (c i) (par t)) ∨
      ∃ i j, i < j ∧ ¬ GenTriple (c i) (c j) (par t)} =
      (⋃ i, {t : ℝ | ¬ Transversal (c i) (par t)}) ∪
        ⋃ i, ⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : i < j), {t : ℝ | ¬ GenTriple (c i) (c j) (par t)} := by
    ext t; simp
  rw [e]
  exact (Set.finite_iUnion hA).union
    (Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun j => Set.finite_iUnion fun hij => hT i j hij)

name: Clifford.GenPosN.exists_snoc
statement:
theorem GenPosN.exists_snoc {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {c : Fin n → ℂ} (h : GenPosN c) :
    ∃ x, GenPosN (Fin.snoc c x : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 := fun i => by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, j ≠ i := by
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = 0
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, fun e => by rw [← e] at hi; simp at hi⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, fun e => by rw [← e] at hi; simp at hi⟩
    exact (h.1 i j hj.symm).left_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (finite_bad c hc h.1).exists_notMem
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_or, not_exists, not_and, not_not] at ht
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ht
  refine ⟨par t, fun i j hij => ?_, fun i j k hij hjk => ?_⟩
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => exact absurd rfl hij
      | cast j => simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact cd_symm (h1 j)
    | cast i =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact h1 i
      | cast j =>
        simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact h.1 i j fun e => hij (by rw [e])
  · induction k using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      have hi : i ≠ Fin.last n := (hij.trans hjk).ne
      have hj : j ≠ Fin.last n := hjk.ne
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 hi
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 hj
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact h2 i j (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.1 hij)
    | cast k =>
      have hj : j ≠ Fin.last n := (hjk.trans (Fin.castSucc_lt_last k)).ne
      have hi : i ≠ Fin.last n := (hij.trans (hjk.trans (Fin.castSucc_lt_last k))).ne
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 hi
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 hj
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact h.2 i j k (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.1 hij) (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.1 hjk)

name: Clifford.exists_extension
statement:
theorem exists_extension : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : Fin (m + 6) → ℂ, GenPosN c ∧
    ∀ k : Fin 6, c (Fin.castLE (by omega) k) = Counter6.cx k
proof:
| 0 => ⟨Counter6.cx, Counter6.cx_genPosN, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | m + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := exists_extension m
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hc.exists_snoc (by omega)
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc c x, hx, fun k => ?_⟩
    have : (Fin.castLE (by omega) k : Fin (m + 1 + 6)) =
        (Fin.castLE (by omega) k : Fin (m + 6)).castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [this, Fin.snoc_castSucc, he k]

name: Clifford.not_cliffordChain_of_six_le
statement: theorem not_cliffordChain_of_six_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) : ¬ CliffordChain n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 6 := ⟨n - 6, by omega⟩
  intro H
  obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := exists_extension m
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := H c hc
  exact not_chain_of_extends m c he X hX

name: Clifford.cliffordChain_iff
statement: theorem cliffordChain_iff (n : ℕ) : CliffordChain n ↔ n ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H; by_contra hn; exact not_cliffordChain_of_six_le (by omega) H
  · intro hn
    interval_cases n
    · exact cliffordChain_zero
    · exact cliffordChain_one
    · exact cliffordChain_two
    · exact cliffordChain_three
    · exact cliffordChain_four
    · exact cliffordChain_five

name: Clifford.mem_line_of
statement:
theorem mem_line_of {g₀ g₁ z : ℂ} (hg : g₁ ≠ 0) (hz : g₀ - z * g₁ - conj z * conj g₁ = 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, z = g₀ / (2 * g₁) + t • (I / g₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(z * g₁).im, ?_⟩
  have h0 : g₀ = z * g₁ + conj (z * g₁) := by rw [map_mul]; linear_combination hz
  have hw : z * g₁ = ((z * g₁).im : ℂ) * I + (z * g₁ + conj (z * g₁)) / 2 := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp; ring
  rw [Complex.real_smul, h0]
  field_simp
  linear_combination (2 : ℂ) * hw

name: Clifford.collinear_of_line
statement:
theorem collinear_of_line {s : Set ℂ} {g₀ g₁ : ℂ} (hg : g₁ ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ s, g₀ - z * g₁ - conj z * conj g₁ = 0) : Collinear ℝ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd]
  exact ⟨g₀ / (2 * g₁), I / g₁, fun z hz => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_line_of hg (hs z hz); exact ⟨t, by rw [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]; exact ht⟩⟩

name: Clifford.clifford_points_on
statement:
theorem clifford_points_on {a b c d e : ℂ} (h : GenPos5 a b c d e) :
    ∀ z ∈ ({miquel a b c d, miquel a b c e, miquel a b d e, miquel a c d e, miquel b c d e} :
      Set ℂ), cliffordEq a b c d e z = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact h.pos4_abcd.cliffordEq_miquel e
  · have h1 := h.pos4_abce.cliffordEq_miquel d
    rw [cliffordEq, kK_p12354, neg_eq_zero] at h1; exact h1
  · have h1 := h.pos4_abde.cliffordEq_miquel c
    rw [cliffordEq, kK_p12453] at h1; exact h1
  · have h1 := h.pos4_acde.cliffordEq_miquel b
    rw [cliffordEq, kK_p13452, neg_eq_zero] at h1; exact h1
  · have h1 := h.pos4_bcde.cliffordEq_miquel a
    rw [cliffordEq, kK_p23451] at h1; exact h1

name: Clifford.miquel_eq_of_kK_zero
statement:
theorem miquel_eq_of_kK_zero {a b c d e : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (he : e ≠ 0) (hD4 : mD a b c d (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) ≠ 0)
    (hD5 : mD a b c e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj e) ≠ 0)
    (H : ∀ z Z, kK a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) z Z = 0) :
    miquel a b c d = miquel a b c e
proof:
:= by
  have hD4b : mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← conj_mD]; exact (map_ne_zero _).2 hD4
  set N4b := mN (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d
  set D4b := mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d
  have hdj := kK_dj a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e)
    (miquel a b c d) (N4b / D4b - 1)
  rw [H, zero_mul, miquel_mul a b c d hD4] at hdj
  have hV : mN (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d -
      (N4b / D4b - 1) * mD (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) a b c d = D4b := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [hV] at hdj
  have hne : conj a * conj b * conj c * conj d * D4b * (a * b * c * e) ≠ 0 := by
    refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_)
      hD4b) (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha hb) hc) he) <;>
      exact conj_ne_zero' ‹_›
  have key : (mN a b c e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj e) -
      miquel a b c d * mD a b c e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj e)) = 0 := by
    have : conj a * conj b * conj c * conj d * D4b * (a * b * c * e) *
        (mN a b c e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj e) -
          miquel a b c d * mD a b c e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj e)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination -hdj
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hne
  rw [eq_comm, miquel, div_eq_iff hD5]
  linear_combination key

name: Clifford.miquel_all_eq
statement:
theorem miquel_all_eq {a b c d e : ℂ} (h : GenPos5 a b c d e)
    (H : ∀ z Z, kK a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) z Z = 0) :
    ∀ z ∈ ({miquel a b c d, miquel a b c e, miquel a b d e, miquel a c d e, miquel b c d e} :
      Set ℂ), z = miquel a b c d
proof:
:= by
  have ha := h.ab.left_ne_zero; have hb := h.bc.left_ne_zero; have hc := h.cd.left_ne_zero
  have hd := h.de.left_ne_zero; have he := h.de.right_ne_zero
  have D1 := h.pos4_abcd.mD_ne_zero; have D2 := h.pos4_abce.mD_ne_zero
  have D3 := h.pos4_abde.mD_ne_zero; have D4 := h.pos4_acde.mD_ne_zero
  have D5 := h.pos4_bcde.mD_ne_zero
  intro z hz
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · exact (miquel_eq_of_kK_zero ha hb hc hd he D1 D2 H).symm
  · rw [← miquel_p1243 a b c d]
    refine miquel_eq_of_kK_zero ha hb hd he hc D3 ?_ fun z Z => ?_
    · rw [mD_p1243]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 D1
    · rw [kK_p12453]; exact H z Z
  · rw [← miquel_p1342 a b c d]
    refine miquel_eq_of_kK_zero ha hc hd he hb D4 ?_ fun z Z => ?_
    · rw [mD_p1342]; exact D1
    · rw [kK_p13452, H, neg_zero]
  · rw [← miquel_p2341 a b c d]
    refine miquel_eq_of_kK_zero hb hc hd he ha D5 ?_ fun z Z => ?_
    · rw [mD_p2341]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 D1
    · rw [kK_p23451]; exact H z Z

name: Clifford.clifford_two_clean
statement:
theorem clifford_two_clean {a b c d e : ℂ} (h : GenPos5 a b c d e) :
    Cospherical ({miquel a b c d, miquel a b c e, miquel a b d e, miquel a c d e, miquel b c d e} :
      Set ℂ) ∨
    Collinear ℝ ({miquel a b c d, miquel a b c e, miquel a b d e, miquel a c d e, miquel b c d e} :
      Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : CliffordNondeg a b c d e
  · exact Or.inl (clifford_two h hk)
  have hk3 : k3 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) = 0 := not_not.1 hk
  have hon := clifford_points_on h
  have hconj : conj (k1 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e)) =
      k2 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) := by
    rw [map_k1]; simp only [starRingEnd_self_apply]; rw [k2_swap]
  by_cases hk1 : k1 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) = 0
  · left
    have hk2 : k2 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) = 0 := by
      rw [← hconj, hk1, map_zero]
    have hk0 : k0 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) = 0 := by
      have h1 := hon (miquel a b c d) (by simp)
      rw [cliffordEq, kK_expand, hk1, hk2, hk3] at h1
      linear_combination h1
    have H : ∀ z Z, kK a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e) z Z = 0 := by
      intro z Z; rw [kK_expand, hk0, hk1, hk2, hk3]; ring
    exact ⟨miquel a b c d, 0, fun z hz => by rw [miquel_all_eq h H z hz, dist_self]⟩
  · right
    refine collinear_of_line hk1 (g₀ := k0 a b c d e (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) (conj d) (conj e))
      fun z hz => ?_
    have h1 := hon z hz
    rw [cliffordEq, kK_expand, hk3, ← hconj] at h1
    linear_combination h1

name: Clifford.chain3_of
statement:
theorem chain3_of (c : Fin 3 → ℂ) (q : ℂ)
    (hq : OnCircle3 (second (c 0) (c 1)) (second (c 0) (c 2)) (second (c 1) (c 2)) q) :
    ∃ Y, Chain 3 c Y ∧ q ∈ Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o, r, hr⟩ := hq
  have hm : ∀ z, z ∈ ({second (c 0) (c 1), second (c 0) (c 2), second (c 1) (c 2), q} : Set ℂ) →
      z ∈ Metric.sphere o r := fun z hz => by rw [Metric.mem_sphere]; exact hr z hz
  refine ⟨Metric.sphere o r, ?_, hm q (by simp)⟩
  refine ⟨Or.inl ⟨o, r, rfl⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨second (c 1) (c 2), rfl, hm _ (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨second (c 0) (c 2), rfl, hm _ (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨second (c 0) (c 1), rfl, hm _ (by simp)⟩

name: Clifford.chain4_of
statement:
theorem chain4_of (c : Fin 4 → ℂ) (h : GenPos4 (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3)) :
    Chain 4 c {miquel (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := clifford_one h
  refine ⟨_, rfl, fun i => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact chain3_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 0) _ h4
  · exact chain3_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 1) _ h3
  · exact chain3_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 2) _ h2
  · exact chain3_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 3) _ h1

name: Clifford.GenPosN.pos4
statement: theorem GenPosN.pos4 {c : Fin 4 → ℂ} (h : GenPosN c) : GenPos4 (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1 0 1 (by decide), h.1 0 2 (by decide), h.1 0 3 (by decide), h.1 1 2 (by decide),
    h.1 1 3 (by decide), h.1 2 3 (by decide), h.2 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 0 1 3 (by decide) (by decide), h.2 0 2 3 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 1 2 3 (by decide) (by decide)⟩

name: Clifford.GenPosN.pos5
statement: theorem GenPosN.pos5 {c : Fin 5 → ℂ} (h : GenPosN c) : GenPos5 (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1 0 1 (by decide), h.1 0 2 (by decide), h.1 0 3 (by decide), h.1 0 4 (by decide),
    h.1 1 2 (by decide), h.1 1 3 (by decide), h.1 1 4 (by decide), h.1 2 3 (by decide),
    h.1 2 4 (by decide), h.1 3 4 (by decide), h.2 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 0 1 3 (by decide) (by decide), h.2 0 1 4 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 0 2 3 (by decide) (by decide), h.2 0 2 4 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 0 3 4 (by decide) (by decide), h.2 1 2 3 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 1 2 4 (by decide) (by decide), h.2 1 3 4 (by decide) (by decide),
    h.2 2 3 4 (by decide) (by decide)⟩

name: Clifford.exists_gcircle
statement:
theorem exists_gcircle {s : Set ℂ} (h : Cospherical s ∨ Collinear ℝ s) :
    ∃ X, IsGCircle X ∧ s ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨o, r, hr⟩ | h
  · exact ⟨Metric.sphere o r, Or.inl ⟨o, r, rfl⟩, fun z hz => hr z hz⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, v, hv⟩ := (collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd _).1 h
    by_cases h0 : v = 0
    · refine ⟨{z | ∃ t : ℝ, z = p + t • (1 : ℂ)}, Or.inr ⟨p, 1, one_ne_zero, rfl⟩,
        fun z hz => ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hv z hz
      rw [ht, h0, smul_zero, zero_smul, vadd_eq_add, zero_add, add_zero]
    · refine ⟨{z | ∃ t : ℝ, z = p + t • v}, Or.inr ⟨p, v, h0, rfl⟩, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hv z hz
      exact ⟨t, by rw [ht, vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩

name: Clifford.cliffordChain_five
statement: theorem cliffordChain_five : CliffordChain 5
proof:
:= by
  intro c h
  have h5 := h.pos5
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hs⟩ := exists_gcircle (clifford_two_clean h5)
  refine ⟨X, hX, fun i => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨miquel (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4), chain4_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 0) h5.pos4_bcde, hs (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨miquel (c 0) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4), chain4_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 1) h5.pos4_acde, hs (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨miquel (c 0) (c 1) (c 3) (c 4), chain4_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 2) h5.pos4_abde, hs (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨miquel (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 4), chain4_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 3) h5.pos4_abce, hs (by simp)⟩
  · exact ⟨miquel (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3), chain4_of (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 4) h5.pos4_abcd, hs (by simp)⟩

name: Clifford.collinear_iff_conj_mul
statement:
theorem collinear_iff_conj_mul (x y z : ℂ) :
    Collinear ℝ ({x, y, z} : Set ℂ) ↔ conj (y - x) * (z - x) = (y - x) * conj (z - x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := x) (by simp)] at h
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hv y (by simp)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hv z (by simp)
    rw [vadd_eq_add, Complex.real_smul] at hr hs
    rw [hr, hs]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    ring
  · intro h
    by_cases hxy : y = x
    · subst hxy
      rw [Set.insert_eq_of_mem (Set.mem_insert _ _)]
      exact collinear_pair ℝ _ _
    have hd : y - x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hxy
    have hcd : conj (y - x) ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).2 hd
    set w := (z - x) / (y - x) with hw
    have hwr : conj w = w := by
      rw [hw, map_div₀, div_eq_div_iff hcd hd]
      linear_combination -h
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, (t : ℂ) = w := Complex.conj_eq_iff_real.1 hwr |>.imp fun _ h => h.symm
    rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := x) (by simp)]
    refine ⟨y - x, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      rw [vadd_eq_add, Complex.real_smul, ht, hw]
      field_simp
      ring

name: Clifford.transversal_iff
statement: theorem transversal_iff (c d : ℂ) : Transversal c d ↔ ¬ Collinear ℝ ({0, c, d} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [collinear_iff_conj_mul, Transversal]
  simp only [sub_zero]

name: Clifford.triP_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem triP_ne_zero_iff (a b c : ℂ) :
    triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) ≠ 0 ↔ ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have e : triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) =
      (b - a) * conj (c - a) - conj (b - a) * (c - a) := by
    simp only [triP, det3, map_sub]; ring
  rw [collinear_iff_conj_mul, e, Ne, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]

name: Clifford.cross_second
statement:
theorem cross_second {a b c : ℂ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (conj (second a c - second a b) * (second b c - second a b) -
        (second a c - second a b) * conj (second b c - second a b)) *
      ((conj a - conj b) * (conj a - conj c) * (conj b - conj c) * ((a - b) * (a - c) * (b - c))) =
      triP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) ^ 2 * cycP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := conj_sub_ne_zero hab; have h2 := conj_sub_ne_zero hac
  have h3 := conj_sub_ne_zero hbc
  have h4 := sub_ne_zero.2 hab; have h5 := sub_ne_zero.2 hac; have h6 := sub_ne_zero.2 hbc
  simp only [map_sub, conj_second]
  simp only [second, triP, cycP, det3]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Clifford.cycP_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cycP_ne_zero_iff {a b c : ℂ} (hab : Transversal a b) (hac : Transversal a c)
    (hbc : Transversal b c) (htri : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)) :
    cycP a b c (conj a) (conj b) (conj c) ≠ 0 ↔
      ¬ Collinear ℝ ({second a b, second a c, second b c} : Set ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (triP_ne_zero_iff a b c).2 htri
  have e := cross_second hab.ne hac.ne hbc.ne
  have hp : (conj a - conj b) * (conj a - conj c) * (conj b - conj c) * ((a - b) * (a - c) * (b - c))
      ≠ 0 := by
    have := conj_sub_ne_zero hab.ne; have := conj_sub_ne_zero hac.ne
    have := conj_sub_ne_zero hbc.ne
    have := sub_ne_zero.2 hab.ne; have := sub_ne_zero.2 hac.ne; have := sub_ne_zero.2 hbc.ne
    positivity
  rw [collinear_iff_conj_mul, not_iff_not, ← sub_eq_zero (a := conj _ * _)]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e).resolve_right hp
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul, eq_comm] at e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 2 ht)

name: Clifford.onCircleM_iff_mem_sphere
statement: theorem onCircleM_iff_mem_sphere (c z : ℂ) : OnCircleM c z ↔ z ∈ Metric.sphere c ‖c‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.mem_sphere, Complex.dist_eq, OnCircleM,
    ← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), Complex.sq_norm, Complex.sq_norm,
    Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

name: Clifford.genTriple_iff
statement:
theorem genTriple_iff {a b c : ℂ} (hab : Transversal a b) (hac : Transversal a c)
    (hbc : Transversal b c) :
    GenTriple a b c ↔ (¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ) ∧
      ¬ Collinear ℝ ({second a b, second a c, second b c} : Set ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [GenTriple, triP_ne_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h1, (cycP_ne_zero_iff hab hac hbc h1).1 h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h1, (cycP_ne_zero_iff hab hac hbc h1).2 h2⟩

name: Clifford.mem_sphere_eq
statement:
theorem mem_sphere_eq {o z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (h : z ∈ Metric.sphere o r) :
    (z.re - o.re) ^ 2 + (z.im - o.im) ^ 2 = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.mem_sphere, Complex.dist_eq] at h
  rw [← h, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; simp; ring

name: Clifford.det4_col1
statement:
theorem det4_col1 (k₁ k₂ k₃ x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ x₄ y₄ : ℝ) :
    det4 (k₁ * x₁ + k₂ * y₁ + k₃) x₁ y₁ 1 (k₁ * x₂ + k₂ * y₂ + k₃) x₂ y₂ 1
      (k₁ * x₃ + k₂ * y₃ + k₃) x₃ y₃ 1 (k₁ * x₄ + k₂ * y₄ + k₃) x₄ y₄ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold det4 det3; ring

name: Clifford.cD_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cD_eq_zero {Y : Set ℂ} (hY : IsGCircle Y) {a b c q : ℂ} (ha : a ∈ Y) (hb : b ∈ Y)
    (hc : c ∈ Y) (hq : q ∈ Y) : cD a b c q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hY with ⟨o, r, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, v, -, rfl⟩
  · have e : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere o r, z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 =
        2 * o.re * z.re + 2 * o.im * z.im + (r ^ 2 - o.re ^ 2 - o.im ^ 2) := fun z hz => by
      linear_combination mem_sphere_eq hz
    rw [cD, e a ha, e b hb, e c hc, e q hq]
    exact det4_col1 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · obtain ⟨ta, rfl⟩ := ha; obtain ⟨tb, rfl⟩ := hb; obtain ⟨tc, rfl⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨tq, rfl⟩ := hq
    simp only [cD, det4, det3, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring

name: Clifford.chain2_eq
statement: theorem chain2_eq {c : Fin 2 → ℂ} {p : ℂ} (h : Chain 2 c {p}) : p = second (c 0) (c 1)
proof:
:=
  Set.singleton_eq_singleton_iff.1 h

name: Clifford.chain3_mem
statement:
theorem chain3_mem {x y z : ℂ} {Y : Set ℂ} (h : Chain 3 ![x, y, z] Y) :
    IsGCircle Y ∧ second y z ∈ Y ∧ second x z ∈ Y ∧ second x y ∈ Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hY, h⟩ := (h : IsGCircle Y ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∃ p, Chain 2 (![x, y, z] ∘ i.succAbove) {p} ∧ p ∈ Y)
  obtain ⟨p0, e0, m0⟩ := h 0
  obtain ⟨p1, e1, m1⟩ := h 1
  obtain ⟨p2, e2, m2⟩ := h 2
  rw [chain2_eq e0] at m0; rw [chain2_eq e1] at m1; rw [chain2_eq e2] at m2
  exact ⟨hY, m0, m1, m2⟩

name: Clifford.chain4_cD
statement:
theorem chain4_cD {x y z w q : ℂ} (h : Chain 4 ![x, y, z, w] {q}) :
    cD (second z w) (second y w) (second y z) q = 0 ∧
    cD (second z w) (second x w) (second x z) q = 0 ∧
    cD (second y w) (second x w) (second x y) q = 0 ∧
    cD (second y z) (second x z) (second x y) q = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := (h : ∃ p, ({q} : Set ℂ) = {p} ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 4, ∃ Y, Chain 3 (![x, y, z, w] ∘ i.succAbove) Y ∧ p ∈ Y)
  rw [← Set.singleton_eq_singleton_iff.1 hp] at h
  have e0 : ![x, y, z, w] ∘ Fin.succAbove 0 = ![y, z, w] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have e1 : ![x, y, z, w] ∘ Fin.succAbove 1 = ![x, z, w] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have e2 : ![x, y, z, w] ∘ Fin.succAbove 2 = ![x, y, w] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have e3 : ![x, y, z, w] ∘ Fin.succAbove 3 = ![x, y, z] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨Y0, h0, q0⟩ := h 0; obtain ⟨Y1, h1, q1⟩ := h 1
  obtain ⟨Y2, h2, q2⟩ := h 2; obtain ⟨Y3, h3, q3⟩ := h 3
  rw [e0] at h0; rw [e1] at h1; rw [e2] at h2; rw [e3] at h3
  obtain ⟨g0, a0, b0, c0⟩ := chain3_mem h0; obtain ⟨g1, a1, b1, c1⟩ := chain3_mem h1
  obtain ⟨g2, a2, b2, c2⟩ := chain3_mem h2; obtain ⟨g3, a3, b3, c3⟩ := chain3_mem h3
  exact ⟨cD_eq_zero g0 a0 b0 c0 q0, cD_eq_zero g1 a1 b1 c1 q1, cD_eq_zero g2 a2 b2 c2 q2,
    cD_eq_zero g3 a3 b3 c3 q3⟩

name: Clifford.second_eq
statement:
theorem second_eq {c d z : ℂ} (h : c ≠ d)
    (hz : conj c * d - c * conj d = z * (conj c - conj d)) : second c d = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [second, div_eq_iff (conj_sub_ne_zero h)]; exact hz

name: Clifford.chain5_mem
statement:
theorem chain5_mem {a b c d e : ℂ} {Y : Set ℂ} (h : Chain 5 ![a, b, c, d, e] Y) :
    IsGCircle Y ∧ (∃ q, Chain 4 ![b, c, d, e] {q} ∧ q ∈ Y) ∧
      (∃ q, Chain 4 ![a, c, d, e] {q} ∧ q ∈ Y) ∧ (∃ q, Chain 4 ![a, b, d, e] {q} ∧ q ∈ Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hY, h⟩ := (h : IsGCircle Y ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 5, ∃ q, Chain 4 (![a, b, c, d, e] ∘ i.succAbove) {q} ∧ q ∈ Y)
  have e0 : ![a, b, c, d, e] ∘ Fin.succAbove 0 = ![b, c, d, e] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have e1 : ![a, b, c, d, e] ∘ Fin.succAbove 1 = ![a, c, d, e] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have e2 : ![a, b, c, d, e] ∘ Fin.succAbove 2 = ![a, b, d, e] := by funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have h0 := h 0; have h1 := h 1; have h2 := h 2
  rw [e0] at h0; rw [e1] at h1; rw [e2] at h2
  exact ⟨hY, h0, h1, h2⟩
